contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #159: Erdős’s reciprocal-sum conjecture and quasipolynomial Szemerédi bounds.

Audit the reduction from the common-derivative system through lattice extraction to graded factorization in OpenAI, Quasipolynomial Bounds for Arithmetic Progressions, September 23, 2026, foundations/02-symbols.tex lines 974-1203. This does not assert the main density theorem.

definitions.rational: one controlled common denominator; coefficient numerators are unrestricted
definitions.slow: the coefficient of t^alpha has norm at most exp(poly(p)) times the actual T^(-alpha)
definitions.uniformity: the degree is fixed; group and parameter dimensions grow polynomially in p; side lengths need not be comparable
definitions.graded_data: U is a controlled rational graded Lie subalgebra; V_1=0 and [U_i,V_j] is contained in V_(i+j)

claims.natural_statement: Under the exact hypotheses of prelim:lattice, let N=n+m and B=delta^(-1)*((N+2)*R)^N*l^(m+1). If min(T_i)>B, every conclusion of prelim:lattice holds with B as the norm, rational-basis height and common-denominator bound, independently of all entries of M and Y.

For fixed s>=2 and controlled rational graded data U,V with [U_i,V_j] contained in V_(i+j), the exact derivative system prelim:derivative-system implies B=aPb with a slow, b denominator-bounded rational, log(P) in W, W_1={v in K intersect U_1:[v,K] subset V_2}, and W_j=U_j intersect V_j for j>=2. Bounds remain exp(poly(p)) without numerator or aspect-ratio bounds.

For every group acting additively and every additive right cocycle Y, common-fiber uniqueness and the derivative-system transformation and absorption identities hold exactly. This is the algebraic core only, not a formalization of lattice extraction or the density theorem.

For fixed degree s>=2, a positive-density family Y_h(B)=s_h+Ad_B(r_h)+Z modulo V with one common Z, controlled slow shift errors and one controlled rational denominator yields B=aPb in the graded algebra W of C_GRADED_RECOVERY, uniformly in growing dimensions, unequal side lengths and unrestricted coefficient numerators. The sufficient minimum-side threshold is exp(poly(p)).

The executable certificate exactly replays the declared symbolic identities and anisotropic unrestricted-numerator constructions. Its finite algebraic checks are supporting evidence, not a replacement for the all-dimensional and all-fixed-degree proof.
Manuscript Theorem ap:main: for each k>=3 there exist C_k,c_k,epsilon_k>0 with r_k(N)<=C_k*N*exp(-c_k*(log N)^epsilon_k) for all N>=2. Unverified in this audit.

Manuscript Corollary ap:reciprocal follows from ap:main by dyadic summation: every positive-integer set of divergent reciprocal sum contains progressions of every finite length. Not established independently here.
Manuscript ap:iteration:closure closes the finite-horizon iteration using the triangular dimension and width forecasts and ap:increment. Unverified in this audit.
Manuscript ap:increment preserves old determining equations and controls fresh rank and width losses by descending triangular recurrences. Unverified in this audit.
Manuscript ap:absolute gives a density increment whose fresh rank is polynomial in logarithmic inverse mean independently of ambient dimension. Unverified in this audit.
Manuscript active replacement, return and extraction preserve the formal determining projections required for triangular pullback, using prelim:step-drop. Unverified in this audit.
Manuscript relative cube detection and scalar return admit lower-degree comparison using prelim:step-drop. Unverified in this audit.

Manuscript Lemma prelim:step-drop: a biased vertical degree-s niltest of controlled complexity has X=EPR with E slow, R denominator-bounded rational, log(P) in controlled rational graded W and eta(W_s)=0. The whole lemma is not formally certified here.

The manuscript normalized-square, lower-degree induction and compatible-splitting steps produce a common fast subgroup and the stated common-derivative system. These antecedents are distinct from the reduction certified by this mission.

import Mathlib

namespace StepDropAudit

theorem common_fiber
    {H G : Type*} [Group H] [Group G]
    (π : H →* G) (U : Subgroup H) {x y : H}
    (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U) (hxy : π x = π y) :
    x * y⁻¹ ∈ U ⊓ π.ker := by
  constructor
  · exact U.mul_mem hx (U.inv_mem hy)
  · change π (x * y⁻¹) = 1
    simp [hxy]

section Cocycle

variable {G A : Type*} [Group G] [AddCommGroup A] [DistribMulAction G A]
variable (Y : G → A) (hY : ∀ x y, Y (x * y) = Y x + x • Y y)

theorem common_derivative
    (a b d : G) (e m u z v : A)
    (h : Y (a * b * d) - e - (a * b * d) • m =
      u + a • z + (a * b) • v) :
    Y b = a⁻¹ • (e + u - Y a) + b • (v + d • m - Y d) + z := by
  have h' := congrArg (fun q : A => a⁻¹ • q) h
  simp only [hY, smul_sub, smul_add, mul_smul, inv_smul_smul] at h'
  calc
    Y b =
        (a⁻¹ • Y a + Y b + b • Y d - a⁻¹ • e - b • (d • m)) -
          a⁻¹ • Y a - b • Y d + a⁻¹ • e + b • (d • m) := by abel
    _ = (a⁻¹ • u + z + b • v) -
          a⁻¹ • Y a - b • Y d + a⁻¹ • e + b • (d • m) := by rw [h']
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [smul_sub, smul_add]
      abel

theorem transformed_derivative
    (a c b : G) (s r z : A)
    (h : Y (a * c * b) = s + (a * c * b) • r + z) :
    Y c = a⁻¹ • (s - Y a) + c • (b • r - Y b) + a⁻¹ • z := by
  have h' := congrArg (fun q : A => a⁻¹ • q) h
  simp only [hY, smul_add, mul_smul, inv_smul_smul] at h'
  calc
    Y c = (a⁻¹ • Y a + Y c + c • Y b) -
        a⁻¹ • Y a - c • Y b := by abel
    _ = (a⁻¹ • s + c • (b • r) + a⁻¹ • z) -
        a⁻¹ • Y a - c • Y b := by rw [h']
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [smul_sub]
      abel

theorem transformed_lift
    (a c b : G) (s r : A)
    (h : s = (a * c * b) • r) :
    a⁻¹ • s = c • (b • r) := by
  simp only [h, mul_smul, inv_smul_smul]

theorem absorption
    {K : Type*} [AddCommGroup K]
    (B : G) (S R : K →+ A) (hSR : ∀ k, S k = B • R k)
    (y s r : A) (k ks kr : K)
    (h : y = s + B • r + S k) :
    y = (s - S ks) + B • (r - R kr) + S (k + ks + kr) := by
  rw [h]
  simp only [map_add, smul_sub]
  rw [hSR kr]
  abel

end Cocycle

theorem bracket_correction
    {E A : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [AddCommGroup A]
    (Q : E →+ A) (p a b : E) (s r : A)
    (hp : Q p = s - r) (ha : Q a = s) (hb : Q b = -r) :
    Q (p - a - b) = 0 := by
  simp only [map_sub, hp, ha, hb]
  abel

end StepDropAudit

routes.retired_because: The explicit all-dimensional extraction theorem proves that the greedy pivot minor is unchanged by every real lower-unitriangular shear. Its bound delta^(-1)*((n+m+2)*R)^(n+m)*l^(m+1) contains no entries of M or Y.
